title: Sanna sounds you out for a job

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Hey! Uh, sorry to interrupt you. I was just thinking... nah. Never mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! Uh, sorry to interrupt you. I was just thinking... nah. Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: It's just I saw where you work. Pretty cool!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's just I saw where you work. Pretty cool!

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I wouldn't normally do this. I'm not good at interviews or making a good first impression, really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't normally do this. I'm not good at interviews or making a good first impression, really.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: A job. I need to work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A job. I need to work.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I guess so. I mean, not really. I should be honest, right? It's not my dream job or anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess so. I mean, not really. I should be honest, right? It's not my dream job or anything.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I'm saying all the wrong things. Let me tell you about myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm saying all the wrong things. Let me tell you about myself.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Sanna. Sanna Sinamon. Nice to meet you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sanna. Sanna Sinamon. Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: What else do you want to know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What else do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Hospitality? No. No way. I was a cave spelunker. Diving into old ruined domes beneath the city superstructure and finding lost techs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hospitality? No. No way. I was a cave spelunker. Diving into old ruined domes beneath the city superstructure and finding lost techs.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I have some amazing experience that makes me the perfect candidate for the job. I mean I was a cave spelunker. Diving into old ruined domes beneath the city superstructure and finding lost techs!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have some amazing experience that makes me the perfect candidate for the job. I mean I was a cave spelunker. Diving into old ruined domes beneath the city superstructure and finding lost techs!

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I agree.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I agree.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Look, I'm smart. Not the smartest, but you know, decent. And I work hard. I mean as hard as anyone else in this job. Maybe harder, cos I'm desperate.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'm smart. Not the smartest, but you know, decent. And I work hard. I mean as hard as anyone else in this job. Maybe harder, cos I'm desperate.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I am! That has to count for something right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am! That has to count for something right?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Soon! Let me just wrap up some things. I'll come by early next week... boss. Can I call you boss? Whatever. We can work it out. Thank you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Soon! Let me just wrap up some things. I'll come by early next week... boss. Can I call you boss? Whatever. We can work it out. Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: It was a breakup. A... really bad one. Apocalyptic. One where, like... the other person is sewn into the threads of everything in your life and when they're torn out, they take most of you with them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was a breakup. A... really bad one. Apocalyptic. One where, like... the other person is sewn into the threads of everything in your life and when they're torn out, they take most of you with them.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I'll be fine. But now I'm broke. I'm lost. I need... something. This job won't change much, but it will give me a new start.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be fine. But now I'm broke. I'm lost. I need... something. This job won't change much, but it will give me a new start.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Think about it. If you need me, I'll be here. I... don't have anywhere else to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think about it. If you need me, I'll be here. I... don't have anywhere else to go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah it is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This isn't anyone's dream job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This isn't anyone's dream job.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right. You're not good at first impressions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right. You're not good at first impressions.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're right. You're not good at first impressions.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're right. You're not good at first impressions.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Start with your name.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Start with your name.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you done this work before?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you done this work before?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you done this work before?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you done this work before?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why should I hire you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why should I hire you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not too relevant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not too relevant.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why should I hire you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why should I hire you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why should I hire you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why should I hire you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You really think this is a good job for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really think this is a good job for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You really think this is a good job for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You really think this is a good job for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sound desperate.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sound desperate.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sound determined.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sound determined.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ugh, fine, I need the help anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh, fine, I need the help anyway.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ugh, fine, I need the help anyway.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ugh, fine, I need the help anyway.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need to know more first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to know more first.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need to know more first.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need to know more first.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you so desperate for this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you so desperate for this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you so desperate for this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you so desperate for this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's something you're not telling me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's something you're not telling me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's something you're not telling me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's something you're not telling me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's very descriptive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's very descriptive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When can you start?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When can you start?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm still not sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm still not sure.
